CHAPTER.VERS: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.

And he said, truth
say
you that this poor widow
in more
all
And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,

And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign
when these things shall come to pass?

And he said, heed
not deceived for many
come in my name saying I am
and the time near go
not therefore after them

Then said he unto them, Nation
rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom
And he spake to them a parable; Behold the tree and all the trees

And in the daytime he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called
of Olives.
And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
